messages:
maya: Heads-up — proposing a new canary "heatmap" panel that aligns runtime + infra signals so PMs/ops can spot regressions across slices. Need to agree on inputs and a telemetry contract before we wire the console.
jon: +1. Core inputs I think: p50/p95/p99 token latency, request duration, success/error rate, CPU/GPU util, queue depth, KV cache hit rate, inflight requests. Tag by rollout_id, slice, route, model_version, region.
liam: Watch out for cardinality. If we tag by route+slice+rollout every minute we'll blow up metrics. Can we pre-aggregate in runtime and emit rollup metrics per (rollout, slice, route) rather than per-request labels?
sophia: From a UX POV we need side-by-side compare (control vs candidate), percent delta, absolute change, and a tiny sparkline per metric. Also add a simple significance flag (green/yellow/red) so PMs don't chase noise.
ara: Instrumentation proposal: runtime emits histograms for request_duration and token_latency with label set {rollout_id, slice, route, model_version, pool}. Then metrics pipeline computes p50/p95/p99 and exposes aggregated series like: "canary.p95.{route}.{rollout}.{slice}". For cardinality we only create series for active rollouts.
jon: Sample PromQL sketch (pseudo):

p95_control = histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_bucket{rollout="control"}[5m])) by (le))
p95_exp = histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_bucket{rollout="candidate"}[5m])) by (le))
regression = (p95_exp - p95_control) / p95_control

We should compute regression delta and also an EWMA-smoothed delta for dashboard stability.
liam: Agree on pre-aggregation. Runtime can emit a small set of aggregated counters per 1m window: {count, sum, buckets} per (rollout, slice, route). That keeps cardinality bounded and still supports histogram_quantile downstream.
sophia: Thresholds — product suggests alert if regression > 10% p95 OR error_rate delta > 2% AND request_count > 1000 in the window. We also want a toggle in Console to ignore tiny slices (<1% traffic).
maya: Good call. Need explicit contract: what labels are required, which ones optional, and minimum sample size for a valid comparison. Let's draft the contract in a doc and sync.
ara: Also: add infra signals in the same panel: cpu_util, gpu_util, host_queue_depth. These should come from infra metrics with the same rollout/slice tag where possible; otherwise map to the rollout pool.
liam: Implementation concern: infra metrics often come at host granularity. We'll map host -> pool -> rollout in the metrics pipeline join. Costs here: joins increase processing cost.
jon: For significance, we can run a simple t-test or use bootstrap. But t-test on p95 is sketchy; better to use bootstrap on request durations. We'll provide a "confidence" score (0-1) and a binary pass/fail.
sophia: UX: include sample_size, confidence, and a quick note: "insufficient data" when sample < threshold. Also allow toggling to show raw distributions.
maya: Ownership — propose:
- eng-runtime (liam + jon): emit aggregated histograms and rollout labels
- observability (ara): pipeline transforms + PromQL derived series, significance calc
- eng-platform (maya): Console panel implementation + UX
- product (sophia): thresholds and rollout defaults

Is everyone ok with that split?
liam: ok from runtime side. We'll add a feature flag to enable the extra aggregates per rollout. Default off for older clusters.
ara: I'll prototype the pipeline transform and a Grafana panel with mock data. Need an example rollout_id and sample schema.
sophia: I'll write the UX spec and include screenshots for side-by-side and heatmap modes.
jon: One more thing: quotas/ingest. eng-sre asked we throttle non-critical telemetry during spikes. Recommend: telemetry sampling policy: 100% for active rollouts, 1% for non-rollout traffic.
liam: We can support that easily in runtime.
deploy-bot: deploy 1823457000 by liam succeeded — emitted rollout_id=canary-2026-03-20
maya: Nice — that will give us concrete data. Action items: liam draft telemetry PR (agg schema) by Tue, ara prototype panel by Wed, sophia produce UX spec by Fri, maya will draft contract doc today. We'll sync Thu 11am.
jon: I'll add PromQL examples + bootstrap script to the PR.
ara: FYI: metric cost estimate = ~0.8k series per active rollout across all slices; I'll put numbers in the doc.
maya: Thanks all :thumbsup:
